label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交把整数与浮点格式说明中的 'n' 类型放进新宏 FMT_DEPRECATED_N_SPECIFIER（默认未定义）之后。这与“新功能被默认关闭的宏包住、fuzz 构建不开宏导致代码不可达”的隐式 configuration 阳性在表面上一样，fuzz 构建也确实没有定义该宏。但 'n' 只是 'L' 的别名：被宏挡住的只是一个 case 标签，背后的 on_num() / locale 处理仍可经 'L' 到达。定额 fuzz 下这两处代码在多个种子中被执行，harness 无需修改，属于隐式 configuration 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit moves the 'n' presentation type of integer and floating-point specs behind a new macro FMT_DEPRECATED_N_SPECIFIER (undefined by default). On the surface this looks like a silent configuration positive, where a feature is wrapped in an off-by-default macro that the fuzz build does not define, and indeed the fuzz build does not define it. But 'n' is only an alias of 'L': the macro hides a case label, while the on_num()/locale handling behind it stays reachable through 'L'. Under the fuzz budget both code sites run in several seeds; the harness needs no update: silent configuration negative.
